source.title: Waltz in D♭ major “Minute”, Op. 64 No. 1

bars.description: Play bars 1–36, repeat 21–35, take second ending 37, then continue through 125. The central melody and final return are written out; the published MIDI already unfolds this exact repeat order.

endpoints.basis: Inspected source-pitch overlays show the genuine opening A-flat4 within the first half-second; the broad initial search incorrectly chose a later recurrence at 3.7 s despite passing numerical gates. The final F3/A-flat3/F4 chord near 117.03 s is followed by the notated rest.

provenance: Engraving uses the original complete scoreAll variable and definitions preceding the first score block, preserving all written pitches, repeats and controls. The unrelated legacy MIDI-only block calls the obsolete one-argument Scheme unfold-repeats API; it is not parsed by this print wrapper. Published MIDI extraction is unchanged.

Read content/listen/chopin-waltz-op64-1-nguyen-xuan.mjs and cache/analysis/chopin-waltz-op64-1-nguyen-xuan.txt; broad middle and return timings are compatible with the explicit source repeat. Their coarse boundaries are not independent bar annotations.
Source RH/LH MIDI tracks inspected; source sec2.ly contains the repeated bars 21–35 and alternate endings 36/37. Staves identify notation allocations, not independent contrapuntal voices.
The final bar includes a written rest after the last left-hand chord; MIDI sounding notes end at quarter 419 while the performed bar sequence extends to quarter 420.
